title: QueueImport
description: Phase 1E local Story Queue import file. References story/scene content by file path, resolved relative to this file's own directory — it does not embed story/scene content inline. Added in Phase 1E to match src/models/queue.py; supersedes the inline-story shape shown in examples/queue-import.json prior to this phase (that shape predated Phase 1C's actual StoryInput model and does not match it — see the Phase 1E implementation report).

queue_item_id.description: Must be unique within this queue file's items array.

story_input_path.description: Path to a StoryInput JSON file, resolved relative to this queue file's own directory (never the process working directory). Must not resolve outside that directory — no override exists in Phase 1E to allow escaping it.

scene_plan_path.description: Path to a ScenePlan JSON file, resolved the same way as story_input_path.

owner_notes.description: Owner-facing only — never read by the render pipeline, may be Arabic or any language.

output_subdirectory.description: Optional override for where this project's manifest is saved under the CLI's --output-root: <output-root>/<output_subdirectory or the built project_id>/manifest.json. Resolved and traversal-checked against --output-root the same way story_input_path/scene_plan_path are checked against the queue directory.

enabled.description: Required, no default — every entry must explicitly opt in or out of an import run. Disabled entries are reported but never written.
